blocks.x: IoT, Twin & Robotics for Automotive & Discrete Manufacturing — sensing, simulating, acting — the operations stack that turns physical assets into self-correcting systems applied to the automotive & discrete manufacturing operating unit of Manufacturing & Industrial.

Automotive and discrete plants chase three numbers — OEE, escapes and launch time. Sensor fabric, vision inspection and scheduling intelligence move all three simultaneously, while IATF traceability and IT/OT security raise the baseline every program must respect.

items: Legacy lines uninstrumented; OEE components and energy per unit are estimates.
Defect detection by eyes/sampling; escapes reach customers and recalls cost millions.

blocks.x: The pattern composes Connected Products & Smart Devices, Smart Infrastructure, Buildings & Cities, Connected Products & Smart Devices from the IoT, Digital Twin & Robotics tower, wired into the unit's workflows (Line changeover sequencing, Vision inspection, Predictive maintenance) on BI & Analytics Platform and EEMS Platform. Governance inherits the sector frame — IATF 16949 among others — with evidence generated by the delivery itself.

items: Simulate before you cut steel — plant, fleet and product twins with governed physics and data.
Cameras into instruments — inspection, safety and counting at the edge, inside policy.
Fix it before it fails — RUL models wired into planning, spare parts and work orders.
retrofit sensing on live lines with governed telemetry (OEE components real)
